info.title: Wealth Master API

get.summary: Calculate current net worth for the authenticated owner
get.description: One repeatable-read snapshot of opening balances plus non-deleted ledger movements. Positive balances are assets; negative balances are liabilities. Includes archived accounts and investment cash, excludes future-opening accounts. Native currencies remain separate; no FX conversion or security valuation. Business date uses APP_BUSINESS_TIME_ZONE. Read-only; no CSRF token required.

200.description: Exact native-currency totals and account contributions; empty arrays when no eligible accounts exist.

403.description: MFA verification, enrollment or recovery proof required

openingAmount.description: Exact decimal string. Credit-card amount must be non-negative.

balanceMeaning.description: BALANCE for non-card accounts. AMOUNT_OWED is stored negative; IN_CREDIT positive.

openingBalance.description: Exact signed opening balance, not a current valuation.

hasActivity.description: Locks financial setup and prevents deletion when history exists.
